primary_sources.source_name: Indian cement company annual reports and BRSR filings FY2024-25
TERI Decarbonization Roadmap for the Indian Cement Sector

source_metadata.methodology: Percentiles are directional ratios calibrated from public annual-report cost disclosures and operating KPIs for major listed Indian cement producers. Category overlaps must not be summed. Plant configuration, regional freight radius, fuel mix and clinker-versus-grinding mix materially affect comparability.

RAW_MATERIALS.source_note: Limestone, gypsum, fly ash, slag, corrective materials and other inputs; derived from peer material-cost disclosures.

POWER_ENERGY.source_note: Power and fuel is commonly one of the two largest cement cost pools; peer annual-report calibration.

LOGISTICS.source_note: Primary and secondary freight, handling and depot cost; highly dependent on lead distance and modal mix.

PLANT_MAINTENANCE.source_note: Repairs, refractory, shutdown services and critical spares for asset-intensive continuous-process plants.

PACKAGING.source_note: PP/HDPE bags and packing operations; varies with bulk-sales share and resin prices.

CONVERSION_COST.source_note: Plant labour and conversion overhead excluding raw materials, energy, freight, packing and depreciation.

limestone_correctives.source_note: Quarry extraction, royalty/DMF/NMET, purchased limestone, gypsum and corrective materials.

kiln_fuel.source_note: Coal, petcoke and conventional kiln fuel; sensitive to landed fuel price and specific heat consumption.

alternative_fuels_raw_materials.source_note: AFR sourcing, pre-processing, quality control and handling net of gate-fee economics.

clinker_conversion.source_note: Kiln and mill conversion overhead excluding separately benchmarked fuel and power.

plant_power_whr.source_note: Purchased power, captive generation O&M and WHR operations excluding kiln fuel.

kiln_refractory_mro.source_note: Refractory, shutdown contractors, mechanical/electrical MRO and critical spares.

grinding_media_additives.source_note: Grinding media, grinding aids, performance enhancers and selected cement additives.

cement_packaging.source_note: Bag procurement, packer consumables and loading; affected by packed-versus-bulk mix.

primary_secondary_freight.source_note: Road and rail freight from plant to depot/customer and secondary distribution.

rail_siding_depot.source_note: Rail siding operations, terminal handling, depot rent and warehouse operations.

quality_lab_bis.source_note: Physical/chemical labs, calibration, sampling and BIS licensing/testing controls.

environment_carbon.source_note: Pollution-control O&M, CEMS, water, waste, carbon data and environmental compliance; excludes major capex.
